sloka: सर्व लक्षण संपन्नम् न्यग्रोध परि मण्डलम् ।सत्य संधम् महाभागम् रामम् अनुव्रता ॥३-४७-३४॥
transliteration: sarva lakṣaṇa saṁpannam nyagrodha pari maṇḍalam ।satya saṁdham mahābhāgam rāmam anuvratā ॥3-47-34॥

translations.english: I am the loyal wife of venerable Rama who is endowed with all excellences, a refuge to all like a spreading banyan tree, and a votary of truth.
